name: 共指链分析
description: 检查 共指 分辨率 chains 以识别 AI生成的 text through abnormal entity tracking and pronominal reference 模式.
useCase: 通过不一致或过于简化的实体引用链检测AI文本
mechanism: Constructs 共指 chains linking mentions of the same entity throughout the text (代词s, noun phrases, proper names). AI生成的 text often shows shorter 共指 chains, less complex reference 分辨率s, and occasional entity confusion—where referents are ambiguously or incorrectly resolved. The method 测量 chain length 分布, referential distance, and chain branching complexity.
source: Dugan, L. et al. (2024) - RAID: A Shared Benchmark for Robust Evaluation of Machine-Generated Text Detectors, ACL
algorithm: Coreference Resolution + Chain Statistics + Anomaly Scoring
parameters: 模型: neural 共指 resolver, Min chain length: 2 mentions, Metrics: chain density, avg distance, branching factor, Text min: 200 words
strengths:
• Captures deep discourse-level 连贯性
• Effective on long-form narratives and essays
• 检测 subtle entity tracking failures
• Orthogonal to surface-level 特征
limitations:
• 计算成本高 for long texts
• Coreference 分辨率 itself is imperfect
• Short texts yield too few chains for 分析
• Performance depends on 共指 model quality

references.title: Dugan, L. et al. (2024). RAID: A Shared Benchmark for Robust Evaluation of Machine-Generated Text Detectors. ACL.
Clark, K. & Manning, C. D. (2016). Deep Reinforcement Learning for Mention-Ranking Coreference Models. EMNLP.
Pu, J. et al. (2023). On the Zero-Shot Generalization of Machine-Generated Text Detectors. EMNLP Findings.
